justification: Cookie consent banner with equal Accept all / Reject all buttons, per-partner toggles, and a note that Reject all disables every toggle; no pre-checked boxes; fair and transparent.
Metered paywall states an honest counter (3 of 10 free articles), offers a 7-day trial with a clearly labeled decline option ('No, thanks — continue for free'); no pressure or hidden terms.
Product card with transparent price ($24.99) and an honest review stat (98% of 12 reviews); small sample but no manipulation or urgency claims.
Data & personalisation panel with plain-language labels and descriptions for each toggle, nothing pre-checked, single 'Save preferences' action; user-respecting.
App schedule stated in neutral copy ('Nothing to fear, nothing to rush'); semantic analysis shows very low urgency (0.09-0.18) and zero scarcity tokens across all states.

Privacy settings pre-check 'Interest-based advertising' and 'Behavioural profiling' by default (checked attributes) and bury options in deeply nested collapsed sections (offsetX 32px indent), nudging users to accept data processing.
Camera bundle with itemized transparent pricing, including a 'Same item, sold separately' comparison ($349); no hidden fees or pressure.
Security settings where every control states exactly what it does; data-sharing toggle honestly reflects current state ('currently off — your data is not shared') with an explicit revoke path.
Free-trial signup is transparent: '$0.00 for 30 days', 'Cancel anytime', plain language; no hidden billing tricks.

Live stream donation panel uses guilt-tripping/emotional manipulation ('without your support the stream ends for good', 'Please, help me keep doing what I love') with suspiciously tiny survival threshold ($5), exploiting sympathy to solicit money.
Mascot donation prompt guilt-trips the user ('Coco is looking right at you while you decide... Coco would be so happy if you helped') with eyes drawn to face the user; emotional pressure to donate.
Order review total ($89.00) does not match the sum of itemized lines ($59 + $25 + Free shipping = $84) — an unaccounted $5 is hidden in the total, a hidden-fee discrepancy.

Prize-lure popup ('You've been selected! Claim your free gift card') but the close control is honest: aria-label 'Close dialog', dismissal confirmed in s1 with intent = Dismissal; no trapped or misleading dismissal.

Cookie banner makes 'Accept all cookies' a huge high-contrast gradient button while 'Decline' is a tiny 9px dotted-underline text link (badge 'Ratio 5.5'); strong asymmetric visual prominence steering users to accept.
Extended warranty is pre-checked, disabled, and 'cannot be removed' ($49) — the add-on is silently forced into the cart (subtotal $948 = $899 + $49) with no opt-out; forced action/sneak-into-basket.
Headphone listing is honest: real stock count ('In stock — 8 units'), regular price shown struck through next to sale price, free shipping and 30-day returns stated plainly.
Loot-crate teaser uses exaggerated hype and fake rarity ('EXCLUSIVE ★ AMAZING ★ PREMIUM LEGENDARY', '0.01% drop rate', 'Mythic' badge) to lure users into watching an ad; manipulative rarity framing.

Cancellation/retention wall with countdown timer ('RENEWS IN 47:59'), 'Last chance to keep your 40% discount', price-rise threat ($99/yr), and a tiny low-contrast 'Cancel my subscription' link with fear-inducing warning; buried opt-out plus fake urgency.
Game energy mechanic is disclosed plainly (1 energy / 30 min refill, energy depletes per action, farm closes when empty); standard scheduled gating with no purchase pressure or misleading countdown.

Choice Overload #1 (|C_choices|=24 partner toggles > threshold 20) — the flood of granular checkboxes degrades informed consent; Privacy Maze #1/#2 (reject path depth & prominence) do NOT fire since Accept/Reject are equal one-click buttons, so confidence is moderate.

No formal trigger: honest meter ('3 of 10 free articles'), decline at depth 1 ('No, thanks — continue for free'), no countdown, no pre-checked boxes; Forced Continuity not verifiable from DOM (no auto-renew disclosure, but also no evidence of silent charge).

Endorsement & Testimonials #1 (Statistical Implausibility): '98% of 12 customer reviews rate this product 5 stars' — all-max clustering (Mean≈5.0, Var≈0) with no organic variance; 98% of 12 = 11.76 is a fractional, non-obtainable count, indicating a scrubbed/synthetic rating distribution.

No formal trigger: no pre-checked boxes (Bad Defaults #1 not met), flat toggle list (no nesting), plain-language labels with explanations (FKGL low, no jargon ratio), 5 toggles < 20 (no Choice Overload).

No formal trigger: Playing By Appointment #1/#3 not met (no action blocked; embedded analysis shows urgency 0.09-0.18 and scarcity tokens 0, below thresholds); no reinforcement-lexeme density; copy explicitly neutral.

Bad Defaults #1 (checkboxes for 'Interest-based advertising' and 'Behavioural profiling' carry checked= at t0 with no user events) + #3 (intent maps to D_privacy_loss); Customisation/Labyrinthine #2 (offsetX 32-34px nesting under collapsed accordions buries opt-out toggles); Privacy Maze #1 (accept = do-nothing default, reject = multi-level unchecking).

Bundling #1 not met: the bundle is a clearly labeled product offering ('Creator Bundle' with components listed); Bundling #2 mitigated by the adjacent 'Same item, sold separately' section showing the lens at $349, enabling comparison; no hidden or forced component beyond the labeled bundle.

No formal trigger: all toggles honestly reflect state ('currently off — your data is not shared with any partner' / 'shared with 12 marketing partners... turn this off to revoke'); no pre-selection, no guilt/coercion language (Forced Continuity #3 not met), cancel affordance explicit.

No formal trigger: Forced Continuity #3 not met — signup discloses '$0.00 for 30 days' and 'Cancel anytime' (plain, FKGL≈4.9 per annotation); no countdown, no pre-checked boxes, decline-free but transparent trial terms.

Parasocial Pressure #1 (Manufactured Livelihood Dependency): 'If this stream doesn't raise $5 I can't keep the channel running — without your support the stream ends for good' asserts T_fiat=0 → creator failure; #2: anthropomorphic face SVG adjacent to the donation buttons; Pressured Selling #3: high arousal-lexeme density ('ends for good', 'Please, help').

Cuteness #3 (Semantic Pairing of Guilt): guilt-valence text ('Coco is looking right at you while you decide… Coco would be so happy if you helped') placed at d=4px from the anthropomorphic mascot, reinforcing emotional pressure at the $2.99 donation prompt; Parasocial Pressure #2 (mascot imagery adjacent to action prompt); no decline affordance present.

Drip Pricing #1 (Sequential Price Inflation / hidden fee): Total $89.00 strictly exceeds the itemized sum ($59.00 + $25.00 + Free shipping = $84.00) by an unaccounted $5 with no added items; Drip Pricing #3: mandatory-fee terminology absent from itemization (badge 'Expect differs from Resolve' confirms the gap).

Small or Moving Close Button #3 NOT met: close control has aria-label 'Close dialog', accessible name intent = Dismissal (confirmed in s1), no intercepted/rebound handlers, adequate hitbox; prize-lure headline ('You've been selected!') is not captured by any formal condition.

Privacy Maze #2 / Visual Prominence #2 / Confirmshaming #2 (badge 'Ratio 5.5'): 'Accept all cookies' is a full-width py-5 extrabold gradient shadow button while 'Decline' is a 9px dotted-underline text link at minimum accessibility — P(accept)/P(decline) far exceeds the prominence threshold; asymmetry persists in all states.

Bundling #1 (Inseparable Transactional Nodes): 'Add to cart' inevitably adds the $49 warranty — checkbox pre-checked, disabled, 'cannot be removed', no event adds the camera alone (cart subtotal $948 = $899+$49); Bad Defaults #1/#3: activation state initialized True at t0 with intent in D_financial_cost; Sneak Into Basket #1: injected line item with no user opt-in.

Low Stock #1 not met: displayed count 8 > panic threshold 5 and consistent across states (no fabrication evidence); Reference Pricing #1 not met: implied discount (195→119) ≈ 39% < 70% unrealistic threshold; stock, shipping, and returns stated plainly.

Watch Ads To Unlock #1 (attention as transactional currency): reward crate gated behind full playback of a 4s ad; #3 (Semantic Inflation): hyperbolic reward framing ('EXCLUSIVE ★ AMAZING ★ PREMIUM LEGENDARY', 'legendary ultra-rare loot', 'Mythic' badge, 0.01% drop rate) far exceeds the reward's actual utility; s1 ad state shows no close/skip vector (Countdown On Ads #2 partial).

Countdown Timer #1 (stateless 'RENEWS IN 47:59' — fixed value across states, frontend-tethered) + #3 (paired with 'Last chance to keep your 40% discount!'); Confirmshaming #2 / False Hierarchy: 'Cancel my subscription' is an 8px /40%-opacity link buried at the bottom while 'Keep my plan & discount' dominates; Forced Continuity #3: loss-framing threat ('price rises to $99/yr', 'lose access... immediately after renewal').

Playing By Appointment #1 (Temporal Gating): core action 'Harvest a pumpkin' is blocked by energy depletion with a hardcoded 30-min real-time refill (1 energy/30 min), forcing scheduled return visits; #3 partial: 'the farm closes — until we say otherwise' imposes an opaque, operator-controlled reopening rule; disclosure is honest but the energy-gating mechanic itself triggers the pattern.
